pill.desc: clear, colorless to pale brownish-yellow solution in a single-dose prefilled syringe

clues.kinetics: Average absolute bioavailability after subcutaneous injection is 62%. Clearance combines general protein-degradation routes, including the liver reticuloendothelial system, with target-mediated clearance.
clues.substance: Has a molecular weight of about 149 kilodaltons. Sterile and preservative-free, and the vial form is a lyophilized powder.
clues.product: A BLA product in 75, 150 and 300 mg prefilled syringes and autoinjectors, and 150 mg vials, dosed every 2 or 4 weeks.
clues.safety: Boxed warning for anaphylaxis, which can occur after the first dose or beyond 1 year. Contraindicated after severe hypersensitivity to it or its ingredients; nasopharyngitis and headache are common in children.
clues.indication: Moderate to severe persistent asthma with allergen sensitivity, chronic rhinosinusitis with nasal polyps, food allergy, and chronic spontaneous urticaria.
clues.mechanism: Binds IgE and inhibits its binding to the high-affinity IgE receptor on mast cells, basophils and dendritic cells, causing receptor down-regulation.

tell: An anti-IgE antibody with a boxed warning for anaphylaxis and an elimination half-life of 26 days in asthma.
